taskName: Distributed Saga Orchestrator with Dual-Write Mitigation
rawOutputSnippet:
### 1. Dual-Write Problem Architecture

Dual-write vulnerability occurs when writing to a local database and publishing to an event broker in uncoordinated operations. A crash between these actions produces state divergence.

Implement the Transactional Outbox Pattern combined with Change Data Capture (CDC).
